_comment: Tier 0 ground truth for ΔT = TT − UT, derived from JPL Horizons by solving for the TT epoch whose lunar longitude matches a UT-tagged request at the same Julian date. Method and error budget are documented in notes/horizons-deltat.mjs. Regenerate with `node notes/horizons-deltat.mjs`.
method: lunar-longitude match between a UT-tagged and a TT-tagged Horizons request
